# Qlean

Qlean marks ancestor and descendant relationships in the file tree and the outline, and exposes per-scheme accent colors together with an HSL picker for precise color control. It also restyles headers, inline formatting, checkboxes, buttons and toggles, offers glassmorphism panels, and adjusts tables with centered cells and an optional full-width layout.

![Qlean screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/froq0/Qlean/HEAD/assets/Qlean.png)

